function.name: get_template
function.description: Retrieves a retrosynthetic template and other information by its ID.

template_id.description: Identifier of the retrosynthetic template to retrieve.

function.name: apply_template
function.description: Applies a retrosynthetic template to a molecule. If one template is applicable to different groups, all possible outcomes are returned.

molecule_smiles.description: SMILES string of the target molecule.

template_id.description: Identifier of the retrosynthetic template to apply.

function.name: verify_step
function.description: Verifies if a retrosynthetic step is valid. This tool might fail for intramolecular reactions.

molecule_smiles.description: SMILES string of the target molecule.

precursors.description: List of SMILES strings representing the precursor molecules. - Provide as an array of strings, e.g., ["item1", "item2"]

function.name: search_template_catalog_by_criteria
function.description: Searches the retrosynthetic template database based on specified criteria. The search criteria refer to the forward reaction.

molecule_smiles.description: SMILES string of the target molecule.

functional_groups_broken.description: List of functional groups that are broken in the forward reaction. None will result in not filtering with this criterion.

functional_groups_formed.description: List of functional groups that are formed in the forward reaction. None will result in not filtering with this criterion.

bonds_formed.description: List of bonds that are formed in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6", "6-8"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.

bonds_broken.description: List of bonds that are broken in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6", "6-8"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.

bonds_order_changed.description: List of bonds whose order is changed in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6 (1.0->2.0)"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return. Default is 10.

function.name: get_available_functional_groups
function.description: Returns a list of available functional groups for querying the database.

function.name: verify_route
function.description: Verifies if a synthesis route follows the expected schema.

route.description: JSON string representing the synthesis route.

function.name: search_catalog_by_smiles
function.description: Searches a catalog for available precursors.

smiles_list.description: List of SMILES strings representing the chemicals to search for. - Provide as an array of strings, e.g., ["item1", "item2"]

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 5.

function.name: is_buyable
function.description: Checks if a list of molecules are commercially available.

smiles_list.description: List of SMILES strings representing the molecules to check. - Provide as an array of strings, e.g., ["item1", "item2"]

function.name: deprotect_molecule
function.description: Removes protecting groups from a molecule represented by a SMILES string.

molecule_smiles.description: SMILES string of the molecule with protecting groups.

function.name: detect_protection_groups
function.description: Detects protecting groups in a molecule and their positions.

smiles.description: SMILES string of the molecule to analyze.

function.name: detect_functional_groups
function.description: Detects functional groups in a molecule represented by a SMILES string.

smiles.description: SMILES string of the molecule to analyze.

function.name: map_reaction_smiles
function.description: Maps atoms in a reaction SMILES string using attention-guided atom mapping. Sometimes, the mapping may help to get the templates to work.

reaction_smiles.description: Reaction SMILES string to be mapped.

function.name: smiles_to_cas
function.description: Converts a SMILES string to a CAS number.

molecule_smiles.description: SMILES string of the molecule to convert.

function.name: cas_to_smiles
function.description: Converts a CAS number to an isomeric SMILES string.

cas_number.description: CAS number of the molecule to convert.

function.name: check_smiles_reaction_template_matching
function.description: Checks if the SMARTS of a reaction template matches any substructure in the given SMILES.

smiles.description: SMILES string of the molecule to check.

template_id.description: ID of the reaction template to check.
